title: Zoho Books Purchase Approval: No Bill or Purchase Order Without a Yes
headline: No bill without *approval*

description:
Make sure every bill, purchase order and vendor credit is approved before it moves on: in Zoho Books go to Settings > Approvals (under Organization) > Purchase Approval tab > Enable Purchase Approval. The default is 'All the approvers can approve'; you can instead configure multi-level approval with up to 10 levels and a specific approver for each level. Submitted transactions show as Pending Approval; approvers open them and click Approve, or Reject with a reason.

Sources (checked 17 Nov 2026):
- Zoho Books FAQ - enable approvals for purchase transactions: https://www.zoho.com/books/kb/transaction-approval/enable-purchase-transaction-approval.html
- Zoho Books help - Transaction Approval Workflow: https://www.zoho.com/ae/books/help/transaction-approval/transaction-approval-workflow.html

lines: Who approved that bill? In Zoho Books, you can make sure someone always does.
Turn on purchase approval, and bills, purchase orders and vendor credits wait for a yes.
Open Settings, and under Organization, click Approvals.
Switch to the Purchase Approval tab.
